verdict: A street built in Blender from one sentence, a camera move along it, then a flood through the same move, with an original score. The flood works: water fills the street and the move holds. The set doesn't: the boxes standing in for cars and the grey blocks at the end of the street still look like a blockout, because the keyframe edit didn't dress them. The brief asked for golden hour and the light came out flat. We checked the score by measurement only.
peak_note: Peak is this run's own ComfyUI and tools, read from nvidia-smi every 2 seconds. The card was shared with other work. Time adds up each stage's own work, not the wait for the shared card.

values.brief: a narrow downtown street at golden hour with old brick shopfronts

stages.label: The set
stages.does: Plans the block from the brief and builds it in Blender at real scale, with textures made for it.
stages.licence: GPL, runs as a separate tool
stages.note: Built, but plain: the far buildings are grey blocks.
stages.prompt: a narrow downtown street at golden hour with old brick shopfronts

stages.label: The shot
stages.does: Blender renders the camera path, Qwen-Image 2.1 dresses the first and last frames, and H3 fills between them.
stages.note: The keyframes still look like a blockout: box cars, grey blocks for buildings, flat light. Its time includes Blender's CPU passes and any wait for the shared card inside the shot; we didn't split those out.
stages.prompt: The camera moves slowly along the empty brick street at golden hour. Warm low light, long shadows, a little dust in the air.

stages.label: The flood
stages.does: LTX-2.5 runs a flood through the same clip, keeping the street and the camera move.

stages.label: Dry, then flooded
stages.does: Runs the two clips one after the other.
stages.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

stages.label: The score
stages.does: An original instrumental for the two clips.
stages.prompt:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 70. key is D, and scale is minor. Dark orchestral.
Global Emotional Progression: A held low note grows into rolling drums as the water arrives.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: An empty street, then a wall of water.
Sonics & Production Profile: Huge low end, wide strings.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: No vocals. Purely instrumental.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: Low strings, timpani.
Secondary: Brass swells.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Slow steady pulse, drums enter halfway.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Swells and rises into each new section.

stages.label: Marry picture and score

rejected.why: The box's memory killer stopped ComfyUI before this chain started. This is its first full run.
